retryMax.description:
If it's zero, the agent will not retry the target function.
If it's not zero, the failure of target function will initiate correcting the spec by LLM.
And it keeps retrying the correction and executing the target function until executing successfully
or reaching either this retry max or the #retryTimeoutSec.

retryTimeoutSec.description:
When the retry was initiated, the agent will retry to execute and correct the spec until
executing successfully or reaching either the #retryMax or this timeout.

NOTE: this time does not include the initial attempt.

promptTemplateReflexionAgent.description: The prompt used to correct the eval spec during the retry process.

llmModelNameReflexionAgent.description: The LLM model used to answer the question. Must correspond to a {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig}.

rationaleLambda.description:
Lambda to apply to the eval spec, e.g. an f_string of the different parts of the spec, an LLM verbalizing the spec, or the spec itself.
Defaults to the identity function

preProcessLambda.description:
Lambda to apply to the eval spec to enable customized behaviors (e.g. default/blacklist projections, default/max limits).
Takes in {@link Genai.StructuredQuery.Spec} and returns the pre-processed {@link Genai.StructuredQuery.Spec}.
Defaults to null so won't apply

postProcessingRenameColumns.description:
If true and `postProcessLambda` is not provided, will reformat each table column name to "TargetType.FieldName" format.
For example, the original `aircraft.location.id, max(a.b.c, d.e.f)` will change to `Genai.Airport.id, max(B.c, E.f)`.

postProcessLambda.description:
Lambda to apply post-processing to the retrieved data table.
If it is not provided, then `postProcessingRenameColumns` dictates whether any renaming should be done.

removeInvalidFieldsInProjections.description:
If true, will remove invalid fields in projections.
It's turned off by default but will be activated in the last run of retrying {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.EvalQuery.SpecProcessor#tableFromSpec}.
Then we can ensure the final spec is valid.
